deployments_detail.use: Company expanding AI use in steel production; SAELING research project extends AI applications with a sustainability focus (company innovation blog)
voestalpine Rotec smart-manufacturing ML model (spring 2025) analyzing production-facility parameters in real time and assessing their impact on quality metrics

Computer-vision visual defect detection at voestalpine Tubulars recognizes cracks in the hollow billet and other surface/end-face defects on tube products during production. [voestalpine (in-house computer vision)]
Machine-learning models at voestalpine Stahl Donawitz predict longitudinal cracks in cast billets before they appear, improving quality management in continuous casting. [voestalpine (in-house ML)]

OCR plus sensor-data fusion on cloud platforms at the Linz site to unequivocally identify material objects and track them as they move through the factory (material tracing). [voestalpine (in-house, cloud-based)]

AI-based predictive maintenance / condition monitoring in the High Performance Metals Division improves equipment availability and optimizes capacity utilization, reducing energy use and CO2 emissions. [voestalpine (in-house)]

Intelligent Turnout / points condition-monitoring product (zentrak, Digital Performance on Track) with sensor+AI predictive maintenance that detects the risk of a points failure that would cause a line closure; sold commercially to railway infrastructure operators. [voestalpine Railway Systems (zentrak / ROADMASTER SCM)]
Optical AI measuring system at voestalpine Grobblech for final inspection of roll-bonded clad plates, measuring plate thickness and geometry. [voestalpine (optical measuring system)]
deployments_detail.value: +/-100 micrometer accuracy; more than one million measuring points within ten minutes

deployments_detail.use: Data-based AI assistance systems at voestalpine Wire Germany (Finsterwalde) for wire-drawing production: sensor-based anomaly detection and predictive maintenance (e.g., vibration/oscillation early-warning of bearing damage) and comparison of production parameters against targets. [voestalpine Wire Technology (in-house)]

Shopfloor AI 'Lighthouse Project' at voestalpine Krems: predicts sawblade wear on flying saws in roll-forming lines from operational signals (current, power, momentum) and surfaces a SCADA traffic-light indicator to optimize blade-change timing and reduce scrap/downtime. [AVEVA (Advanced Analytics + CONNECT data services)]

AI surface-inspection projects at voestalpine Wire Rod Austria: line-scan-camera surface defect detection on the rolling line (proactively alerts control-center staff to possible errors), acoustic monitoring of the rolling mill for equipment faults, and AI support for the eddy-current testing unit. [voestalpine Wire Technology (in-house)]

greentec steel: machine-learning process-parameter optimization and a digital twin predict finishing parameters (cooling-stop temperature, cooling rate, rolling speed; target hardness/tensile strength) to avoid energy-intensive corrections at Linz and Donawitz electric-steel plants. [voestalpine (in-house ML / digital twin)]

SAELING research project applies AI to optimize energy efficiency of ~2,000 saws, milling machines and grinders (built on the HPMconnect program, 250+ connected units) in the High Performance Metals Division at Kapfenberg. [voestalpine HPM with University of Klagenfurt, KU Leuven, Siemens]
deployments_detail.value: targeted 20-30% energy efficiency increase; ~21 GWh current annual consumption

deployments_detail.use: voestalpine High Performance Metals multicloud AI assistant (IBM) automating order capture and significantly reducing order-processing times
AI/ML liquidity forecasting in the Steel Division predicts incoming and outgoing payments to support financial planning and solvency. [voestalpine (in-house ML)]

Supply-chain optimization in the High Performance Metals Division uses internal and external data to recommend which supply-chain process path is most likely to succeed, presenting recommendations for employee approval. [voestalpine (in-house)]
